categories.label: Victory points this round
categories.help: Points moved on the scoring track this round: scoring-space points, spoon points, bonus die and any chip or card bonuses.

categories.label: Points bought at the end
categories.help: After the last round, points bought at 5 coins or 2 rubies each; enter how many you bought.

categories.label: Last-round pot position
categories.help: How far along your pot you got in round 9. Scores nothing; the furthest wins a tie.

notes: Base game only; Herb Witches, Alchemists, test-tube variant and other expansions excluded. Read from a retailer-hosted copy (1jour-1jeu CDN) of the Schmidt Spiele rulebook, not the publisher site. The rulebook does not say how to compare an exploded pot in the tie-break; use the space your last chip reached. Players 2 to 4 from the rulebook. A fan-made summary (not used) was ignored.
